text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: There you are! I hope you're prepared!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Oooh... Is this some kind of challenge?
Are you
here to duke it out with me?

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
You betcha! I'm here to brawl! I'll show
you my
way's the yummiest!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Turbo! What do you think you're
doing
runnin' off like that?! All I said was
to do it like
Machan.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Sorry to barge in on you like this! We
were
stomping udon noodle dough, and
Hishiama said
to use you as inspiration...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha! No need to stomp the living
daylights out
of it. Try to take shorter,
more precise steps. Oh!
Pretend you're
running with a short stride, like
Machan!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: What?! You mean Machan's good at running and making udon?!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: But I bet my noodles will be waaay yummier! And I'll prove it! I'll be right back!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Ohhh, I see. What a revelation. It never
occurred
to me to use my quick stride to
make udon.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
I'm the better front runner! And the
better udon
stomper! 'Cause I'm the
best, period! So let's go!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Hmmm. Is this a challenge I ought to
accept or refuse?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
What do you think, Trainer? Either way
sounds
yummy to me.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Cooking with everyone might be a good
change
of pace. Then again, it could tire
her out...

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Okay. I'll leave my mark with an
unforgettable
clash.
You're on, Turbo.
choice_data_list: I think I'll pass this time.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
All riiight! Let's go, go, goooo! I'm gonna
wipe the
floor with you!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Good grief... Still, there's nothing like a
rival to
get your competitive juices
flowing!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Know what would make this really epic?
An
audience! I've got permission for you
to use this
space, so knock yourselves
out!

text_block_list.name: Students
text_block_list.text:
What's going on? An udon dough
stomping
competition?
Whoever makes
the best noodles wins?
Hahaha! That's
funny! I wanna try some! ♪

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
So many eyes on me, hehe. It's just as
yummy as I
thought.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
All right, we've got the dough set in
plastic bags!
Now... You have one
minute! ☆ Step on the
dough as much or
as little as you want. ☆ The
most buono
noodles win! ♪

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: On your maaarks... Get seeet... GO!

text_block_list.name: Machan and Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Hyaaaaah!
Raaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Aaaand... time's up! ☆ Let's slice the
dough and
start boiling! ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The moment of truth has arrived. Let's
find out
whose udon is the best!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Buono! ♪ Machan's noodles are so
smooth and
firm! ♪

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Turbo's are a bit too firm. I think they mighta been stomped a bit too heavily...

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Nnngh! You're right... Mine are kinda
chewy...

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Grrr! Machan's are so yummy! I want
seconds!

text_block_list.name: Students
text_block_list.text: Machan's really are good! These might be even better than the stuff from the store! I'll never forget this flavor!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Oh my. An unforgettable flavor? Have I
found a
secret talent lurking within me?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Gasp. Is it possible I can make a bigger impression on the world with my noodles than my running?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
That settles it. It's time to change
course. I'll open
a noodle stand in the
shopping district and it'll be
loved for
generations.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, just kidding. That's not where I'm
meant to
shine.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
If the noodles took center stage and

overshadowed me, it would defeat the
whole
purpose.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I breathe a huge sigh of relief. She's
going to
keep racing. I can't read her, as
usual, but Aston
Machan does seem to
be enjoying herself more
than normal.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Buono! Buono! Both are buono! Beyond
delicious,
both of you! ♪

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Agreed. They both go down great! But if I had to choose one... I'd say Turbo's got the edge.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Really?! I win?!
YAAAAAY!

text_block_list.name: Students
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha! Turbo always works so hard.
Her
noodles are to die for!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
It appears my noodle journey has ended
early,
and in failure. Womp womp.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Well, today was yummy indeed. I'm sure
the great
time we had eating udon
together will leave a
long-lasting
impression on everyone.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
In the end, that's the yummiest thing of
all as far
as I'm concerned.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
A victory would've been more
memorable and
dramatic. At least, that's
what I thought. But since
I lost, the key
thing is to roll with it.
choice_data_list: Does winning or losing not matter to you?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Now it's time for me to deliver a food
critique so
lovely it roots everyone to
the spot in rapt
attention.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Hot! Blow, blow, blow... Glance.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I think I see what she's going for... Either way, she makes for a lovely image as she relishes the noodles. I won't be forgetting this any time soon.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
You're right. I suppose I'd better decline
this time.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
I'm choosing not to participate in this
challenge
so that my true potential
remains a mystery.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
There's a multitude of potential futures
within me.
That's right, I'm Schrödinger's

Machan—Schrödimachan!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Whaaat?! Oh, come on! Why won't you
take on
my noodle challenge?!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. The question of "What if?" is a
tantalizing
one, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
As time goes on, you'll only become
more and
more curious, until eventually
I'm the only thing
you can think about.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
And that's how I'll leave you for today.
We can
compete later. Someday. Okay?

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Nnngh! I don't really get what you're
talking
about, but you said "someday"!
I'm holding you to
that, so don't you
forget!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
I won't. And that goes for everyone else
too.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Don't forget about me.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Ahhh... So that's her plan. How could
anyone
forget after hearing that?
Aston
Machan smiles with satisfaction.
